base: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE production identity-master character sprite for the satirical office/grocery game The Promotion. Output square 1024x1024 PNG. Pure flat exact RGB(255,0,255) background all the way to the edges, no floor shadow, no text, labels, logos or extra objects. A single full-body front-facing person, centred on x=512, top of hair at y=100 and flat level soles at y=924 (total figure height 824). Camera straight on. Chunky 16-bit SNES pixel art, strongly stepped blocky pixel edges, hard continuous black outline of one DESIGN pixel (roughly 8 source pixels), flat cel shading maximum three tones per material, absolutely no gradients, dithering, texture noise or anti-aliasing. Simple slab eyes, tiny nose, small mouth line, short limbs. Head INCLUDING hair from y=100 to y=430 (40% of figure height); neck at about y=430. Hair is compact, not a cloud. Restrained office-cast build range: total width/height between .40 and .65; keep height fixed, vary width according to identity. Arms hang straight down with sleeves, forearms and hands fully connected, hands touch their arms without magenta seams. Feet flat level and side by side, standing still. Bilateral accessory placement; no one-sided pockets, badges, objects or logos. No hot pink, coral, salmon, fuchsia, magenta or purple on figure. Every intended figure colour MUST satisfy min(R-G,B-G)<=40 (safe margin >=20). Skin tones warm beige/brown, never magenta. Magenta appears ONLY in border-connected outside background: absolutely no enclosed magenta pockets, no stray pixels, one connected figure. Distinct identity as specified, without adding decorative details.

characters.desc: Tyson Beck, male bagger age 19. Pale skin, very short dark brown buzzcut with a compact grown-out fringe, bored heavy-lidded eyes, slightly slouched shoulders. Youthful angular face without beard. Narrow lanky read within the stumpy style, width about .43 of height. Short-sleeved white polo, slate blue bib apron reaching mid-thigh, charcoal trousers and plain dark brown shoes. Both arms straight down.

Anjali Raval, female cashier mid-thirties. Brown South Asian skin, black hair pulled symmetrically back into a LOW practical bun (keep visible hair compact; no high bun), calm unbothered expression. Compact upright build, width about .45 of height. Short-sleeved white polo, slate blue bib apron to mid-thigh, charcoal trousers, dark brown shoes. Both arms straight down.

Marguerite Dubois, female cashier in her sixties. Fair aged skin, compact short curled SILVER-GREY hair, reading glasses worn over eyes with symmetrical temples, warm alert faintly amused expression. Width about .46 of height. Short-sleeved white polo, slate blue bib apron to mid-thigh, charcoal trousers, dark brown shoes. Both arms straight down.

Danika Osei, female Front End Manager late twenties. Dark brown skin, BLACK short chunky compact twists close to the head, visibly distinct from a smooth bun or buzzcut. Upright braced watchful posture and alert eyes. Width about .47 of height. Short-sleeved white polo with a centred NAVY TIE visibly exposed under the collar above a slate blue bib apron to mid-thigh, charcoal trousers and dark brown shoes. Both arms straight down.

Garret Voss, male Assistant Manager in his forties. Ruddy but key-safe warm beige skin, thinning sandy hair combed flat symmetrically, soft build width .55 of height, anxious eager-to-please expression. Pale blue short-sleeved button shirt, navy tie, brown belt, charcoal trousers, brown shoes. NO APRON. EXPLICIT POSE EXCEPTION: both arms bend inward and BOTH hands hold one plain blank clipboard flat against the centre of the chest, centred and symmetrical. Clipboard no lettering. Arms continuous with hands, no gaps. Head ratio and fixed height unchanged.

Lorne Petrie, male Store Manager in his fifties. Tanned skin, full compact head of grey hair, thick grey-brown moustache, broad friendly open grin. Comfortable build width .57 of height. White long-sleeved button shirt with BOTH sleeves rolled to elbows, centred dark green tie, charcoal trousers, brown shoes. NO APRON. Arms hang straight down.

Merv Kastelic, male Owner in his sixties. Ruddy key-safe warm beige skin, BALD on top with compact grey hair only at both sides, heavy grey brows, flat appraising unimpressed mouth and eyes, a man counting something. Heavyset build within office Doug range width .64 of height, round belly. White short-sleeved button shirt stretched over belly, centred navy tie TUCKED INTO THE WAISTBAND with end concealed, dark brown trousers, black shoes. NO APRON. Both arms hang straight down. Head remains 40% of total figure height despite belly.

Sandrine Pike, female head-office executive in her forties. Olive skin, black hair severely pulled back smooth and compact, thin rectangular glasses, neutral unreadable expression. Upright width .43 of height. Charcoal blazer over white blouse, charcoal trousers, black shoes. NO APRON, no tie, NO BAG, no asymmetric blazer pocket or brooch. Both arms hang straight down.
